headlineFindings: POE discovered SI at20:21:11.324Z and verified its finalized canonical migration by20:23:28.116Z.
The cited21:19:30 zero-trade feature window had no completed independent audit and no strategy/predictive rejection; it is incomplete evidence, not a valid no-opportunity conclusion.
SI had six separately bounded audited windows later/earlier: five zero-trade windows and one tiny-Sell window; two explicit primary strategy rejections and four independent predictive failures.
The independently indexed20:28–20:36 rally and20:44 collapse lie inside the27m41.441s gap between experimental frozen runs.

The pre-rally20:26:11–20:27:18.326 eligibility overlap did occur in an active run, but SI was not deeply observed there; full pre-rally flow, historical reserves and actual-size quotes remain missing.
A discovered but unobserved/incomplete candidate cannot be labelled a missed profitable trade solely from its later indexed price peak.

limitations: This is a selected single-token lifecycle case, not an independent opportunity population or recall denominator.
Bounded pool-signature audit results do not prove entire-market discovery or historical replay.
No full trade history is retained during SI watch/deferred/stopped intervals; watch activity hints cannot supply missed buys, buyer identities, concentration or net buying.
Current price appreciation and OHLCV bars do not establish a $50 executable entry or exit, historic fees/liquidity, modeled delay/slippage or profitable exits.

The large indexed rally predates the cited21:19 window; the phrase later trading must be checked against exact UTC periods.
No production state, financial state, credentials, research reservations, or counters were changed.
